FAQ | Industrifonden Home Team Portfolio About us News & Insights Meet Us Talent Contact FAQ Our Investment 01 When is the right time to approach Industrifonden about investing? We are interested to invest when your startup has demonstrated initial evidence and is ready to accelerate, usually in Seed or A-round funding. Ideally, contact us at least six months before you plan to close the funding. It is common that we received previous updates from the company and have been able to follow progress for a certain time before the funding process started. 02 What criteria do you use for investments? We focus on unique and scalable innovations. We seek passionate founders and teams with the capability to turn visionary ideas into reality, and concepts that have the potential to revolutionize or create new industries. We believe that mixed teams with complementing capabilities are best positioned to succeed. 03 How should I approach Industrifonden for an investment? Please send your pitch deck to a relevant member of our investment team. Given the high volume of inquiries we receive, only select proposals that fit our focus areas will lead to an initial call or meeting. 04 What is your investment process and how long does it take? Submitted pitch decks areevaluated. Due to the high number of inquiries, we only schedule meetings with those that best align with our investment criteria.

Industrifonden Home Team Portfolio About us News & Insights Meet Us Talent Contact News OlsAro closes €5m seed investment to scale climate-resilient cereal genetics Published 14.10.26 OlsAro, the Swedish AgTech company developing climate-resilient cereal genetics, has raised €5 million in seed funding to develop its SeedAX platform and bring its first salinity-resilient wheat product to market. The round was led by Industrifonden, with Nordic Foodtech VC joining as co-lead. Existing investors Future Food Fund, PINC (Paulig’s venture arm), AgFunder and GU Ventures also participated. The financing follows OlsAro’s €2.5 million pre-seed round in April 2024, bringing the total raised by the Swedish company to date to approximately €7.5 million. Salinity already affects around a tenth of the world’s cropland. Heat and drought are also putting pressure on cereal production, increasing the need for varieties that can maintain yields under these conditions. OlsAro develops cereal traits and varieties, with an initial focus on wheat. Its SeedAX platform combines proprietary genetics and data, AI-driven trait discovery and genetic technologies to identify and validate climate-resilience traits, then integrate them into elite germplasm for commercial seed programmes. EN SV Ticket SIZE - PORTFOLIO COMPANIES FUNDS UNDER MANAGEMENT IPOS Industrifonden was founded by the Swedish government in 1979 as an independent foundation to provide Swedish industry with an innovation growth engine. For more than four decades, we've backed high-tech ventures from first check to global scale – accumulating pattern recognition and knowledge across cycles Our focus is Sweden, but our reach extends across the New Nordics where we participate in strong syndicates alongside local co-investors, backing exceptional companies wherever they're building in the region. Today, we are an independent venture capital fund continuing our legacy by partnering with innovators and entrepreneurs to bring Nordic breakthrough innovations to the world. From QlikTech, Arcam and Oatly to CellaVision, Inriver, and Calliditas, we've backed companies that reshaped their industries – and we exit when the company is ready, not when a fund term ends. We invest in early-stage companies. Our first ticket is often €1–5million, with capacity to invest considerably more over a company's lifecycle.
